chained_applications.description: Define production-ready checklist for agents: edge case handling, graceful degradation, clear errors, observability

Draft sustainability model addressing FFmpeg-style scenarios: funding, contributions, licensing
Identify manual orchestration points and design seamless agent collaboration workflows

ecosystem_assessment.reasoning: Low direct relevance due to domain, infrastructure, user, and technology mismatches. Google innovations (handwriting, images, code editor) address different problems than Chained (agent orchestration, automation). Value lies in transferable principles, not technologies.
ecosystem_assessment.why_not_higher: Technologies don't transfer (computer vision vs. orchestration), different user needs (individuals vs. autonomous systems), different infrastructure (desktop vs. cloud automation)
ecosystem_assessment.why_not_lower: Principles transfer even when technologies don't. Production quality, AI-native design, structured approaches, and sustainability all apply to Chained.

meta_analysis.honest_assessment_value: Maintaining accurate 3/10 rating builds trust. Inflating ratings erodes credibility.
meta_analysis.principle_transfer: Technologies don't transfer, but principles do: production quality, AI-native design, structured approaches, sustainability
meta_analysis.strategic_value: External learning broadens perspective even without immediate application
